title: WarBias: A Bilingual LLM Benchmark of Stereotypes About Internally Displaced People and Veterans
abstract: arXiv:2611.11284v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper contains examples of stereotypes about veterans and displaced people that may be offensive or distressing. Social bias benchmarks for language models commonly examine categories such as gender, race, and religion, often drawn from lists of legally protected characteristics. Veterans and internally displaced people (IDPs) fall outside these lists, and stereotypes about them, which can undermine access to employment, housing, and social participation, remain largely absent from language model evaluation. We introduce WarBias, a Ukrainian-English benchmark of stereotypes about these two groups. Built from a taxonomy of 120 stereotype claims grounded in research and monitoring reports, WarBias contains 1,007 stereotype-counter-stereotype-unrelated sentence triplets and 240 multiple-choice questions per language. translated_title: WarBias：一个关于境内流离失所者和退伍军人刻板印象的双语大语言模型基准
translated_abstract: 本文包含一些关于退伍军人和流离失所者的刻板印象示例，可能具有冒犯性或令人不适。针对语言模型的社会偏见基准通常考察性别、种族和宗教等类别，这些类别往往源自法律保护特征清单。退伍军人和境内流离失所者不在这些清单之列，而关于他们的刻板印象——可能损害其获得就业、住房和社会参与的机会——在很大程度上仍未被纳入语言模型评估。我们提出了WarBias，一个针对这两个群体的乌克兰语-英语刻板印象基准。WarBias基于研究和监测报告构建了包含120条刻板印象主张的分类体系，每种语言包含1,007个“刻板印象-反刻板印象-无关”句子三元组以及240道多选题。乌克兰语三元组由在盲测人类试点中选出的一款乌克兰语语言模型生成，并由至少两名独立（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个聚焦退伍军人和境内流离失所者这两个被主流偏见评估忽视群体的双语（乌克兰语-英语）大语言模型偏见评测基准WarBias，包含120条刻板印象主张、每种语言1,007个句子三元组和240道多选题，填补了语言模型社会偏见评估的空白。
en_tdlr: WarBias introduces the first bilingual Ukrainian-English LLM benchmark targeting overlooked stereotypes about veterans and internally displaced people, comprising 120 stereotype claims, 1,007 sentence triplets, and 240 multiple-choice questions per language, filling a gap in social bias evaluation of language models.
